:::{#thm-ipw-identification}
#### Identification by inverse probability weighting

For $a \in \cb{0, 1}$, write
$\pi_a(\vec{l}) \eqdef \Pf{A = a \mid \vec{L} = \vec{l}}$,
so that $\pi_1 = e$ and $\pi_0 = 1 - e$.
If [consistency](#def-consistency),
conditional [exchangeability](#def-exchangeability) given $\vec{L}$,
and [positivity](#def-positivity) hold, then

$$
\E{Y(a)} = \E{\frac{\indicp{A = a} \, Y}{\pi_a(\vec{L})}}
$$ {#eq-ipw-identification}

:::

::: proof
$$
\ba
\E{\frac{\indicp{A = a} \, Y}{\pi_a(\vec{L})}}
&= \E{\E{\frac{\indicp{A = a} \, Y}{\pi_a(\vec{L})} \mid \vec{L}}}
&& \text{(law of total expectation)} \\
&= \E{\frac{1}{\pi_a(\vec{L})} \E{\indicp{A = a} \, Y \mid \vec{L}}}
&& \text{(pull out } 1 / \pi_a(\vec{L}) \text{, which positivity keeps finite)} \\
&= \E{\frac{1}{\pi_a(\vec{L})} \E{\indicp{A = a} \, Y(a) \mid \vec{L}}}
&& \text{(consistency: } Y = Y(a) \text{ when } A = a \text{)} \\
&= \E{\frac{1}{\pi_a(\vec{L})} \E{\indicp{A = a} \mid \vec{L}} \E{Y(a) \mid \vec{L}}}
&& \text{(conditional exchangeability: } A \ind Y(a) \mid \vec{L} \text{)} \\
&= \E{\frac{1}{\pi_a(\vec{L})} \pi_a(\vec{L}) \E{Y(a) \mid \vec{L}}}
&& \text{(} \E{\indicp{A = a} \mid \vec{L}} = \Pf{A = a \mid \vec{L}} \text{)} \\
&= \E{\E{Y(a) \mid \vec{L}}}
&& \text{(cancel } \pi_a(\vec{L}) \text{)} \\
&= \E{Y(a)}
&& \text{(law of total expectation)}
\ea
$$

:::
